## Summary

## Reproducibility

- [ ] Prime-agent version/commit and model configuration are pinned where relevant
- [ ] Treatment/baseline differences are disclosed
- [ ] Published tables can be traced to retained raw data or deterministic scripts
- [ ] Ambiguous or human-judged scoring is labeled as such
- [ ] No credentials, session URLs, private transcripts, or proprietary data added

## Verification

List the commands used to validate the change.
